abstract.t: This document specifies an architecture for inter-domain source address validation (SAV). The architecture provides a common framework for collecting SAV-specific and SAV-related information from multiple sources, determining the legitimate incoming directions of source prefixes, and using this information to generate SAV table for inter-domain SAV. A SAV agent maintains the collected information in a SAV Information Base (SIB), and the SAV Information Base Manager (SIM) uses the available information to determine the corresponding prefix and legitimate incoming-direction mappings and generate or update the SAV table. This document also defines the architectural components and communication framework of inter-domain SAV, and discusses deployment, operation, convergence, manageability, security, and privacy considerations. It does not define a specific SAV protocol, protocol extension, or SAV table generation algorithm.
